200.description:
`text/event-stream` — SSE blocks `event: <name>
data: <json>

` plus `: keep-alive` (~2 s). Primary payloads: `CompanionChatStreamDelta` / `CompanionChatStreamFinal` / `CompanionChatStreamActions` / `CompanionChatStreamError` / `CompanionChatStreamDone`. Optional extras (`transform`, `turn_stage`) and merged Redis task events share framing.

post.summary: Proactive observation tick: file open / focus / workspace switch → anticipation hint
post.description:
Light-weight tick: persist an observation row, return an anticipation hint without HTTP LLM.

This endpoint deliberately **never** triggers a chat turn. It returns a small ``CompanionHintOut``
the SPA can render as a pre-message bubble. See HCM Module B (project "Mela's Ascension" PR-3).

CompanionStoryAddIn.title: CompanionStoryAddIn
CompanionStoryAddIn.description:
Append one ``story`` row to ``companion_memory_v1`` (HCM Module A — pinned identity anchors).

Story rows are short chronological landmarks the user wants the companion to remember as identity
("first time we …", "the day Arlika forgave …"). They render in the same memory block as facts.
